result.summary: Found 1 minor content issue where a promotional badge displays a meaningless '-0%' discount on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The second restaurant card under the 'Popular right now' section (featuring the pizza graphic) displays a '-0%' discount badge in the top-left corner.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge entirely when the discount value is 0% or null, or ensure the correct promotional percentage is passed to the component.
